artifacts.title: Granting BCO 59 on Marriage Full Constitutional Status

matches.evidence: The CCB found Overture 24 from Tennessee Valley Presbytery, which sought to grant BCO 59's marriage provisions full constitutional status, to be in conflict with the Constitution.

artifacts.title: Granting BCO chapter 59 on marriage full constitutional status

matches.evidence: A Calvary Presbytery overture to elevate BCO 59 to full constitutional status was in conflict because doing so is equivalent to amending the BCO and requires the same multi-stage approval process under BCO 26-2.
